paths.plan-phase.md: #2650: the stall-detection fix moved the bulk of the new gsd_stall_should_recover/gsd_stall_watch logic and its explanatory prose into the lazily-loaded gsd-core/workflows/plan-phase/steps/stall-detection-helpers.md, which is not measured against the frozen ADR-857 Phase 6 PRE_PHASE6 cap. That extraction on its own shrank plan-phase.md. Verification then surfaced two things that grew it back: (1) tests/plan-phase-drift-guard.test.cjs (#913) requires a literal 'ORCHESTRATOR RULE — ALL RUNTIMES' label at every agent spawn site in plan-phase.md itself, so a short label was restored at each of the 5 stall-watch spawn sites (bodies stayed in the extracted reference file); (2) an independent review found PLANNER_OUTPUT_FILE/CHECKER_OUTPUT_FILE were read by gsd_stall_watch but never assigned anywhere — a dead variable that made marker_received permanently unreachable, most severely on the plan-checker spawn, which touches no *-PLAN.md file on a clean PASS and so has no other completion signal. Fixed by binding the real Agent() return via the {outputFile} orchestrator-substitution token (the docs-update.md:471 precedent) at each of the 5 sites, plus a pointer sentence in step 7.99 to where that binding is documented. Net effect still verified under the PRE_PHASE6 cap and the #913 label-count requirement.
